title: 第13章 算计第14章 苏灿拿钱跑了
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
“哟，青山这是去哪儿呀？”
周青山坐在周大爷的对面，別人一问，就让周大爷停了下来，说的时候嗓门不是一般的大：“送我东哥去县医院，嫂子医院里有认识的人，给东哥把腿治一下。”
“那敢情好，战东真是个有福气的人，娶了个好媳妇。”
“哈哈！谁说不是呢？嫂子可不是一般人，人家县里有人，说话办事都比咱们容易。不过这几天家里就剩下三个孩子了，叔叔婶子们晚上多帮忙照看一下，別让有些人在这种时候钻了空子。到时候要是因为什么事闹到县公安局去，丟的可是咱们桃村的脸。你们说是不是？”
大家连忙附和，有的还衝著躺在马车上的陆战东道：“战东，你儘管放心去治腿，孩子们的事不用担心。只要我们这些人在，晚上谁要是敢去找孩子闹事，咱们桃村的人保证不饶他！”
“对对对！谁要是敢在这种时候找麻烦，回头就把他送去公安局！”
周青山听著大家的附和，笑著拱了下手。
苏灿適时的感谢大家。
周大爷扬起鞭子一甩，马车很快离开了。
路上遇到了好几群这样的村民，周青山每次都会多说几句，等马车出了桃村，刚刚他说的那些话再次像长了翅膀一样传了开来。
其实周青山这样做，就是因为在出发前，苏灿特意把他拉到一边叮嘱过的。
今天毕竟跟老陆家闹的不快，那个陆红武是什么样的人她也看清楚了，虽说分家的时候老陆家的人迫於压力分了家，但是她能感觉到那个陆家老二陆红武，根本就不是什么好脾气的人。
万一等他们走了，陆红武趁著天黑找三个孩子的麻烦，一个周东升守在那里根本不是他的对手。
最主要的是，只有孤零零的一间屋，四周连个院墙都没有，晚上动手对陆家人来说再容易不过了。
所以离开桃村之前，她必须让陆家人感觉到压力。
其实苏灿还真没算错，陆家表面上同意了分家，也当著桃村村民的面分了东西。
陆老太太还咬牙拿出了二百块钱，但是他们打的算盘便是等到晚上，把分出去的那些东西能拿回来的全都拿回来。
反正现在陆战东一家大小住的地方只有一间屋，陆战东双腿已经残废了，苏灿不仅是个女人还是个大胖子，行动力上就先差了一大截。
剩下的便是三个孩子，最大的陆文渊也才十岁，这几个人全加在一块都不是陆红武一个人的对手。
分完家之后，苏灿和村民们全都离开后，老陆家的人在堂屋里，就是商量的这个结果。

他们攒著一口气，等到天黑之后，陆红武就会去村里找几个关係不错的人，去陆战东一家五口所在的屋子里抢东西。
反正是晚上，谁能认的出来？
可还没彻底黑下来，老陆家的人就听到一个让人鬱闷的消息。
陆战东那个新来的胖媳妇，居然带著陆战东坐著陆大爷的马车去了县医院，就连周青山也跟著一起去了。
按说家里的两个大人走了，只剩下三个孩子，他们更容易动手。
content_en:
"Hey, where are Qingshan going?"
Zhou Qingshan sat opposite Uncle Zhou. When someone asked, Uncle Zhou stopped and said in an unusually loud voice: "Send Brother Dong to the county hospital. My sister-in-law knows someone in the hospital who can treat Brother Dong's leg."
"That's good. Zhan Dong is really a lucky man. He has a good wife."
"Haha! Who says it's not the case? My sister-in-law is not an ordinary person. There are people in the county who can talk and do things more easily than us. But these days there are only three children left at home. My uncles and aunts should help take care of them at night, so as not to let some people take advantage of the loopholes. If we go to the county public security bureau for something, it will be a disgrace to our Taocun. Don't you think so?"
Everyone hurriedly agreed, and some even said to Lu Zhandong who was lying on the carriage: "Zhandong, feel free to go get your leg treated. Don't worry about the children. As long as we are here, if anyone dares to go to the children to cause trouble at night, we Taocun people will not spare him!"
"Yes, yes! If anyone dares to cause trouble at this time, send him to the public security bureau later!"
Zhou Qingshan smiled and raised his hand after hearing everyone's agreement.
Su Can promptly thanked everyone.
Uncle Zhou raised his whip and flicked it, and the carriage quickly left.
We met several groups of villagers like this on the road, and Zhou Qingshan would say a few more words each time. When the carriage left Taocun, the words he just said spread again like they had wings.
In fact, Zhou Qingshan did this because Su Can specifically pulled him aside and warned him before setting off.
After all, she had an unpleasant quarrel with the old Lu family today, and she could see clearly what kind of person Lu Hongwu was. Although the people of the old Lu family split up due to pressure when the family was separated, she could feel that the second son of the Lu family, Lu Hongwu, was not a good-tempered person at all.
If Lu Hongwu took advantage of the darkness to cause trouble for the three children after they left, Zhou Dongsheng would be no match for him if he stayed there.
The most important thing is that there is only a solitary room with no walls around it. It is extremely easy for the Lu family to do it at night.
So before leaving Taocun, she had to make the Lu family feel the pressure.
In fact, Su Can's calculation was correct. The Lu family ostensibly agreed to the separation and also divided things in front of the Taocun villagers.
Mrs. Lu gritted her teeth and took out two hundred yuan, but their plan was to wait until night to get back all the things they had given out.
Anyway, now Lu Zhandong's family only lives in one room. Lu Zhandong's legs are disabled. Su Can is not only a woman but also a fat man, and his mobility is greatly reduced.
There are three children left, the eldest Lu Wenyuan is only ten years old. All of them together are no match for Lu Hongwu alone.
After the family division, after Su Can and the villagers all left, the old Lu family was in the main room, which was the result of the discussion.
They saved their breath, and after dark, Lu Hongwu would go to the village to find a few well-connected people to grab things from the house where Lu Zhandong's family of five lived.
It's night anyway, who can recognize it?
But before it was completely dark, the old Lu family heard some depressing news.
Lu Zhandong's new fat wife actually took Lu Zhandong to the county hospital in Uncle Lu's carriage, and even Zhou Qingshan went with her.
Ordinarily, with the two adults in the family gone and only three children left, it would be easier for them to take action.
